image_prompts.purpose: Reading support visual for a welcome-week student profile.
image_prompts.visual_description: An adult Fashion Design student in a tidy studio classroom holding a sketchbook near fabric swatches and simple tools, with an approachable academic atmosphere.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a digital watercolor style with clear educational detail and an adult learner tone.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Keep the background uncluttered, show the sketchbook and fabric clearly, and avoid busy decorative elements that distract from the reading task.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid logos, childish cartoon styling, runway glamour poses, and dense background text.
